figures.Fig20.7: Insect-resistant plant with gene of B. thuringiensis. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch20-fig-bt-plant (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book describes golden rice as rice given genes for iron (from beans, Aspergillus and wild rice) and for beta-carotene (from daffodil); 'golden rice' is the beta-carotene line, and the iron-rich rice was a related separate line. The lesson notes this, flagged.
The For Information box on iron and vitamin A deficiency is carried with its figures attributed to the book.
